body: I’m in North Carolina today, speaking to folks at Campbell University (home of the camels!). The good people of the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship will be strongly represented today – a group I am tremendously impressed with and optimistic about. Many have damaged the good name of Baptist in recent years, but these folks represent a different spirit and are moving toward a better future. I return home tonight, and then tomorrow Grace and I leave for Australia, so expect blog posts to be less frequent for the next couple weeks.
